blocks.prompt: 3. Show that: \(2\cos 2\theta = \sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta}}\) [as printed; the left side should be \(2\cos\theta\), see the correction below]
blocks.explanation:
Yahan square root ke andar square root hai (nested root). Aise sawal hamesha andar se bahar ki taraf hal hote hain.
Diya kya hai? Right side \(\sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta}}\). Find kya karna hai? Yeh asal mein kis ke barabar hai.
Rule kaunsa? \(1 + \cos 2x = 2\cos^2 x\), do dafa: pehle \(x = 2\theta\), phir \(x = \theta\).
Plan: andar wala root khatam, phir bahar wala. Aap dekhenge ke jawab \(2\cos\theta\) aata hai, jo kitab ke chhape hue left side se mukhtalif hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: R.H.S. \(= \sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta}}\).
Humein dikhana hai: R.H.S. \(= 2\cos\theta\) (kitab ka left side \(2\cos 2\theta\) chhapai ki ghalti hai).
Tareeqa: \(1 + \cos 2x = 2\cos^2 x\) wali identity \(2 + 2\cos(\ldots)\) ko poora square bana deti hai, aur square ka square root asaani se nikal aata hai. Hum \(0 \le \theta \le \frac{\pi}{4}\) lete hain taake \(\cos\theta\) aur \(\cos 2\theta\) negative na hon aur root seedha cos hi de.

Andar wala root hal karein
\[2 + 2\cos 4\theta = 2(1 + \cos 4\theta)\]
\[= 2(2\cos^2 2\theta) = 4\cos^2 2\theta\]
\[\sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta} = 2\cos 2\theta\]
Kyun: 2 common nikala. Phir \(1 + \cos 2x = 2\cos^2 x\) mein \(x = 2\theta\) rakha, kyunke \(4\theta = 2(2\theta)\). Is tarah \(4\cos^2 2\theta\) bana, jo \((2\cos 2\theta)^2\) hai, aur us ka root \(2\cos 2\theta\).

Bahar wala root hal karein
\[2 + 2\cos 2\theta = 2(1 + \cos 2\theta)\]
\[= 2(2\cos^2\theta) = 4\cos^2\theta\]
\[\sqrt{4\cos^2\theta} = 2\cos\theta\]
Kyun: Ab bahar ke root ke andar \(2 + 2\cos 2\theta\) hai. Wohi identity, is dafa \(x = \theta\) ke saath. \((2\cos\theta)^2\) ka root \(2\cos\theta\).

Natija
\[\sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta}} = 2\cos\theta\]
Kyun: Har root angle ko aadha karta hai: \(4\theta \to 2\theta \to \theta\). Do roots hain, is liye aakhir mein \(\theta\) bachta hai, \(2\theta\) nahi. Isi liye kitab ka left side ghalat chhapa hai.

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) rakh kar
\[\sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 120^{\circ}}} = \sqrt{2 + 1}\]
\[= \sqrt{3} = 2\cos 30^{\circ} \;\checkmark\]
\[2\cos 60^{\circ} = 1 \neq \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 120^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{2}\), is liye \(2 + 2(-\frac{1}{2}) = 1\), us ka root 1, phir \(\sqrt{2 + 1} = \sqrt{3}\). Yeh \(2\cos 30^{\circ}\) ke barabar hai magar \(2\cos 60^{\circ} = 1\) ke nahi. Ek misaal se ghalti pakki ho gayi.
blocks.final_answer: \(\sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta}} = 2\cos\theta\) (jab \(0 \le \theta \le \frac{\pi}{4}\)). Saabit ho gaya, left side ko \(2\cos\theta\) theek kar ke.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein \(2\cos 2\theta = \sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta}}\) chhapa hai, jo ghalat hai. Har square root angle ko aadha karta hai (\(4\theta \to 2\theta \to \theta\)), is liye right side \(2\cos\theta\) banta hai. \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) par chhapa hua left side 1 hai magar right side \(\sqrt{3}\). Sahi sawal: \(2\cos\theta = \sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2 + 2\cos 4\theta}}\) (jab \(0 \le \theta \le \frac{\pi}{4}\)). Exam mein yeh sawal aaye to sahi shakal prove karein aur ek line mein ghalti ki nishandahi kar dein.
